name: bookapp-reader-parallel
description: Four independent investigations, then isolated implementation and a Jev-ready checkpoint.

nodes.prompt: Inspect the BookApp reader API and data flow. Record concrete findings, file paths, risks, and a minimal implementation plan. Do not edit production files.
Inspect the BookApp reader UI and identify the smallest clear UX improvements. Record current behavior, proposed states, and affected files. Do not edit production files.
Inspect the BookApp tests and runtime checks. Propose focused acceptance checks for the reader change and identify missing coverage. Do not edit production files.
Perform a bounded architecture and migration risk review of the reader change. Look for concurrency, data-loss, security, and rollback risks. Do not edit production files.
Synthesize the four analysis artifacts into one implementation plan. Resolve contradictions, name file ownership, and state which work can be parallel and which must be serial.
Implement the backend portion of the synthesized reader plan. Keep the change bounded to the owned files, run focused checks, and report evidence.
Implement the UI portion of the synthesized reader plan. Keep the change bounded to the owned files, run focused checks, and report evidence.

Integrate the backend and UI worktrees into this isolated worktree, run the focused acceptance checks, inspect all dependency evidence, and finish with exactly one AUDIT_VERDICT line. If work is incomplete, emit AUDIT_VERDICT: REVISION_REQUIRED and AUDIT_FINDINGS_JSON: [...].
